messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 9):
"""
If there is any delay beyond three hours, the additional amount if any charged by the hospital shall be borne by the insurer from shareholder’s fund. c. In the event of the death of the policyholder during the treatment, the insurer shall: i. immediately process the request for claim settlement. ii. get the mortal remains (dead body) released from the hospital immediately 17) Settlement of Claims: a) No claim shall be repudiated without the approval of PMC or a threemember sub-group of PMC called the Claims Review Committee (CRC). b) In case, the claim is repudiated or disallowed partially, details shall be conveyed to the claimant along with full details giving reference to the specific terms and conditions of the policy document. c) Pursuant to intimation of the claim, Insurers and Third Party Administrators (TPAs) shall collect the required documents from the Hospitals.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If a hospital charges an additional amount after a delay of more than three hours, who is responsible for paying that amount?","answer":"The insurer must bear any additional amount charged by the hospital beyond the three‑hour delay, using its shareholder’s fund.","facts":["\"If there is any delay beyond three hours, the additional amount if any charged by the hospital shall be borne by the insurer from shareholder’s fund.\""]},{"question":"What steps must an insurer take if a policyholder dies during treatment?","answer":"The insurer must immediately process the claim settlement request and arrange for the mortal remains to be released from the hospital immediately.","facts":["\"In the event of the death of the policyholder during the treatment, the insurer shall: i. immediately process the request for claim settlement. ii. get the mortal remains (dead body) released from the hospital immediately\""]}]}
